rows.title: Paper Pilot: A Human-in-the-Loop Expert System for Evidence-Traceable Scientific Manuscript Generation in Applied Sciences

rows.title: The Digital Apprentice: A Framework for Human-Directed Agentic AI Development

rows.title: When to Adapt: Conditional Memory Adapters for Retention-Preserving Domain Specialization

rows.title: NemoSplat: Feed-Forward 4D Gaussian Splatting for Media-Aware Underwater Reconstruction

rows.title: InterSAGE: The Secure and Verifiable Interoperability Protocol for An Internet of Agents

rows.title: Task-Specified Active Metrological Inspection with Measurement-Steered VLA Manipulation and Deterministic Evidence Gating

rows.title: PIA-Bench: Towards Automated Privacy Impact Assessment with Large Language Models

rows.title: Grounding Agent Memory: Environment-Probing Curation for Enterprise Agents

rows.title: An Evidence Model for Agentic Processes: Evidence Claims, Trust Assumptions, and Policy Assessment

rows.title: Who Maintains Agent Skills? A Longitudinal Study of Human-Governed, AI-Assisted Skill Maintenance

rows.title: A Black Box for Agentic Processes: Blockchain-Anchored Evidence for AI Agent Communication, Human Oversight, and GRC Audits

rows.title: Space2Ground 2.0: A Multi-Source Dataset and Framework for Agricultural Monitoring through Fusion of Street-Level and Satellite Imagery

rows.title: Hybrid Adversarial Defence for Natural Language Understanding Tasks

rows.title: ShopEase: A Generative AI-Based Multi-Agent Framework for Intelligent Enterprise Customer Support Using Hybrid Retrieval-Augmented Generation

rows.title: When Agentic Executions Fail: Detecting and Localizing Runtime Faults from Telemetry

rows.title: ActPlane: Programmable OS-Level Policy Enforcement for Agent Harnesses

rows.title: A2ABreak: Systematic Security Analysis of the A2A Protocol

rows.title: Delegation Without Trust: An Empirical Gap Analysis of Identity, Authorization, and Runtime Governance in Multi-Agent LLM Systems

rows.title: A Multi-Agent Platform for Automated Enterprise Analytics and Insight Generation

rows.title: Exposed by Design: A Dynamic Security Assessment of Internet-Facing MCP Servers at Scale

rows.title: APPA: Recoverable Information-Flow Control for Real-World LLM Agents

rows.title: Ground-Side Mission Plan Compilation with Policy-as-Code Guardrails for Cloud-Native Satellite Platforms

rows.title: FlowGuard: From Signals to Evidence for MCP Security Detection

rows.title: SYNAPSE: A Multi-LLM Orchestrated AI Tutor for Secure Software Development Education with Neurodivergent-First Design

rows.title: The Balkanization of Execution-Security Research for AI Coding Agents: Isolation, Access Control, and Time-of-Check-to-Time-of-Use Vulnerabilities

rows.title: When Should a Failing Robot Ask? Initiating Corrective Human-Robot Dialogue from Audited Sensor Evidence

rows.title: Understanding AI Provider Recommendations in Local Service Markets

rows.title: AI Soccer Analyst: Stage-Aware and Verifiable Human-AI Collaboration for Soccer Data Analysis

rows.title: When Intelligence Becomes Agency: A Theory of Governed, Proactive Agency for Symbiotic AI Systems

rows.title: MIVAIS: A Study Environment for Multi-Agent Mixed-Initiative Visual Analytics Applications

rows.title: InsightToast: Proactive Information Retrieval & Glanceable Visualization in the Side Channel of Data-Rich Meetings

rows.title: VeriForge: Mitigating Latent Knowledge Gaps in Narrative Drafting via Mixed-Initiative Scaffolding

rows.title: ITO: Real-time Browser Tab Orchestration Through Intent Detection

rows.title: Reconstructing Persistent Worlds from Narratives for Narrative-Grounded Interactive Experiences

rows.title: Making Multimodal LLMs Reliable Chart Data Extractors: A Benchmark and Training Framework

rows.title: HiLSVA: Design and Evaluation of a Human-in-the-Loop Agentic System for Scientific Visualization
